title: Show HN: Old Nvidia and ATI tech demos, running again in the browser
excerpt: Graphics card demos by 3dfx, NVIDIA and ATI from 1998 to 2006, running in the browser.
content_html:
Borg

1998 · 3dfx, Voodoo2

A cube with nine textures in five passes, as the first card with two texture units drew it.

Donut

1998 · 3dfx, Voodoo2

A torus with embossed bumps and a reflection, in two passes.

Bubble

1999 · NVIDIA, GeForce 256

A bubble of springs that mirrors its surroundings. Poke it.

Lightning

2000 · NVIDIA, GeForce 256

Hold the steel plate to strike it: the bolt lights bumps, heats the metal and throws sparks.

Grove

2000 · NVIDIA, GeForce 256

Trees grown from a few numbers, lit by fireflies.

Principles of Shading

2000 · NVIDIA, GeForce2

A logo taken apart and shaded again in six steps, from points to bump maps and reflections.

Creature

2000 · NVIDIA, GeForce2

A sea monster under caustic light, 500 fish that avoid it, and a laser.

Grass

2000 · NVIDIA, GeForce 256

A meadow without an end: ten thousand blades bend in the wind and shine like hair.

Small Pond

2000 · NVIDIA, GeForce2

Ripples in a wooden pool mirror photographs of a whole day around it. Click the water.

Toy Soldier

2000 · NVIDIA, GeForce2

A tabletop regiment marches in formation until a wind-up robot scatters the soldiers.

Crystal Ball

2000 · NVIDIA, GeForce 256

A glass globe on a griffin stand. Fly inside to a castle in the snow, and swap it for the other.

Chameleon

2001 · NVIDIA, GeForce3

A chameleon walks along a vine and changes into each of its seven skins in turn.

Zoltar

2001 · NVIDIA, GeForce3

A fortune teller speaks using the original animated face and voice recordings.

Bugs

2002 · NVIDIA, GeForce4 Ti

Sixty alien insects swarm across a junkyard. Toggle Depth Vision to see overdraw.

Wolfman

2002 · NVIDIA, GeForce4 Ti

A werewolf with eight shells of fur breathes, howls, walks and runs down a night street, following the original routine until you pick an action.

Squid

2002 · NVIDIA, GeForce4 Ti

A mechanical squid swims by itself among kelp, fish, bubbles and silt, morphing between its skins. Steer it for a while.

Tidepool

2002 · NVIDIA, GeForce4 Ti

Light bends through a rock pool in a cave. Click the water to drop a drip into it.

Car Paint

2002 · ATI, Radeon 9700

Two-tone paint with metal flakes and clear coat, and how it is built up layer by layer.

NPR Hatching

2002 · ATI, Radeon 9700

A still life in pencil: hatching by tone, ink outlines, shadows in strokes.

Natural Light

2002 · ATI, Radeon 9700

Paul Debevec’s balls of glass and gold, lit by a forest in high dynamic range.

Bear

2002 · ATI, Radeon 9700

Fur of shells and fins, lit along each hair, and a roar.

Dawn

2002 · NVIDIA, GeForce FX

A fairy dances on a branch. Change her expression, or watch her rest in the sun.

Pipe Dream

2003 · ATI, Radeon 9700

Animusic's machine plays itself: every note is a ball that has to land on time.

Double Cross

2004 · ATI, Radeon X800

Ruby's first mission showcases layered hair, reflections, and cinematic depth of field.

Dangerous Curves

2005 · ATI, Radeon X850

A motorcycle chase through tunnels with motion blur and global illumination comparison modes.

The Assassin

2005 · ATI, Radeon X1800

A high-rise confrontation with shadow maps, glowing plasma, and a ten-bit frame buffer.

Box of Smoke

2006 · NVIDIA, GeForce 8

Smoke and water simulated on the card itself. Stir it with the pointer.

Surf

1998 · 3dfx, Voodoo / ATB

Standing in a B-spline sea whose control points ripple from four wandering wave sources.

60Hz / 30Hz / 15Hz

1998 · 3dfx, Voodoo / ATB

The same scene side by side, updated at different frame rates. Watch the bouncing ball.

Demoroom

1997 · 3dfx, Voodoo / ATB

An Egyptian room lit by a projector you steer: slides and a film multiplied over the walls.

ATB-TV

1997 · 3dfx, Voodoo / ATB

A television on a marble stand turns while its 73-frame movie plays on the curved screen.

Flip

1997 · 3dfx, Voodoo / ATB

Anubis, an AT-AT, a dragon, a chrome martini glass and more, turned with the arrow keys.

Grand Bleu

1997 · 3dfx, Voodoo / ATB

The dolphins, sharks, rays, turtles and fish of an underwater demo, each swimming its own animation.

Racing

1997 · 3dfx, Voodoo / ATB

Indy cars lapping a track along the lanes kept in the demo, with five camera views.

Valley of Ra

1997 · 3dfx, Voodoo / ATB

Anubis and Nefertiti trade punches and kicks before a pyramid, playing the demo's own move tables.

Wizards Tower

1997 · 3dfx, Voodoo / ATB

A walk through five rooms of a wizard's tower, each triangle lit by its own light map.
